title: Observe the special encounter descriptor during battle entry
changes: Add a bounded ordinary-input observer for the descriptor-1 packed-owner alias and compare the first reader frame with the original ROM path.
validation: Wine e158-special-alias-ordinary-wine-gpir8qjh reaches original reader 080cd43c at relative frame 186 of the authenticated Giza-to-White-Flowers route, with one typed row request and no raw row requests while the ROM source is poisoned.

The first reader frame matches complete state, guest clock, framebuffer, wide framebuffer, OAM and mixed audio against an original-ROM interpreter; Windows test cross-build ucioguoy passed and the Wine server drained.
limitations: One ordinary interpreter frame and one route do not prove full importer, other scenes or consumers, translated dispatch on this route, Linux, USA or native Windows. No performance measurement.
